bag_policy: Bags larger than 25x25x25 cm are not permitted. Clear bags are recommended. Free bag storage is available outside Gates 1 and 4.
prohibited_items: Weapons, fireworks, glass bottles, drones, laser pointers, and professional camera rigs are prohibited inside the stadium.
re_entry: Re-entry is not permitted once you have scanned your ticket, except for documented medical reasons via the Accessibility Assistance Desk.
water: Free water refill stations are located on every concourse level next to each medical post.
lost_and_found: Lost and found is at the Accessibility Assistance Desk near Gate 6 during the event, and online at fifa.com/lostfound afterwards.
parking: Stadium parking requires a pre-booked permit. Public transit (Line 2 to Tasquena, then light rail) is the recommended route.
tickets: All tickets are digital via the official FIFA app. Screenshots are not accepted at the gate. Ticket transfer closes 2 hours before kickoff.
children: Children of all ages require a ticket. A family quiet zone is available in the Concourse near the sensory room.
smoking: The stadium is smoke-free, including e-cigarettes. Designated outdoor areas are outside Gates 2 and 5.
weather: The stadium bowl is partially covered. In case of lightning within 13 km, concourse shelter announcements will be made in Spanish, English, and French.
